observations.content: Assistant is teaching Vietnamese user for APTIS; user's materials include Listening (audio+docs), Speaking, Writing docs with samples by club topic, Reading series with keys, Grammar ver 2.docx, Vocabulary answer keys, 'mẹo aptis' tips, sample tests, and a separate 'WRITING APTIS' zip.
Assistant taught in Vietnamese framing with English test items, following teach skill Phase 1a quiz probing then Phase 1b goal questions.

Assistant spawned researcher subagent aptis-research (id 25a0a290-d37f-46fb-bd32-1c0e7670955a) to research APTIS structure, 0-50 scoring to CEFR mapping, official practice materials, strategies for B2+, and common Vietnamese pitfalls; result arrives via paseo_get_agent_activity.

Assistant extracted both zips into APTIS/extracted; folders include Tài liệu APTIS (Writing, Reading, Listening/Audio, Đề thi thử mẫu, Speaking, Grammar, Tài liệu khác with Thi thử tại website and ĐÁP ÁN BÀI TẬP BỔ TRỢ) and WRITING APTIS.
Grammar probe Q1 (B1 past perfect 'by the time we arrived...had already started'): user answered correctly.
Grammar probe Q2 (mixed conditional B2/C1): user answered incorrectly, chose 'have studied'; user's note: 'ok mình cứ nghĩ đó là quá khứ đã xảy ra và không thể thay đổi, mình đã sai'.
Grammar probe Q3 (pure 3rd conditional B2): user answered correctly; bracket established that 3rd conditional is solid but mixed conditional is not (tense-per-clause-by-meaning not locked).
Grammar probe Q4 (C1 inversion 'Never before have I heard'): user selected 'I don't know' — genuine knowledge gap, not a wrong guess.
Vocabulary probe Q5 (B2 word 'obscure'): user answered incorrectly, chose 'ambitious', does not know the word.
User asked 'ủa sao dừng rồi?' (why did you stop?); assistant explained the quiz pauses after each answer so it can read results and adapt the next question, then continued probing.
Vocabulary probe Q6 (word formation 'refusal'): user answered correctly but noted hesitation between gerund 'refusing' and derived noun; user showed noun-agreement intuition.
Vocabulary probe Q7 (B1 effect/affect/effort/offer 'effect'): user answered correctly; assistant concluded vocab floor is solid B1, edge around B1+/B2.

Reading probe Q8 (inference about Mai turning down Hanoi job): first quiz attempt failed because correctAnswer 'Mai's decision was influenced by family considerations.' matched no option value; assistant re-issued with correctAnswer='infer-family' and user answered correctly.
Assistant taught the Aptis Reading trap taxonomy: 3 trap types = contradiction, fabrication, over-inference; user's correct answer showed solid reading inference at B1/B2.
Format probe Q9 (scoring scale per skill): user answered correctly that each Aptis skill is scored 0-50 and mapped to CEFR A1-C; assistant noted user has basic test familiarity.

In goal question, user reported prior Aptis result taken 20/07/2024 at 188 Cầu Giấy, Quận Cầu Giấy, Hà Nội, Enrolment Id ESOL~0229120: G/V 40, Listening 48, Reading 44, Speaking 36, Writing 46, Total 174; CEFR overall C, Listening C, Reading C, Speaking B1, Writing C.
User stated they previously reached C level on Aptis general but believes part was luck plus a long period of study; now they have less time.
